findings.problem: Storage decoder40 and domain decoder64 reject valid finalized query responses accepted at HTTP depth64 plus redaction/envelope overhead.
Bulk classification/prune/recovery bypass domain payload and receipt-summary consistency validation.
Management observes only initial signal and can admit later mutations after cancellation.
CLI delivery can mutate cancellation_signal within an already-sealed collection payload.

followup_reproduced.problem: Millisecond-rounded child deadline returns before parent deadline; receipt storage crosses deadline before cleanup allowance begins. Repeated cleanup calls can also reset an early cancellation allowance.
